hooks.statusMessage: Session check: gate 0, pre-commit hook, readiness
Checking which docs this commit made stale
hooks.prompt:
A git commit was just run in this repository: $ARGUMENTS
If it did not create a commit (a dry run, or it failed), answer ok. Otherwise read the commit with git show --stat HEAD and git show HEAD, then decide which of these documents it made wrong or incomplete: AGENTS.md, README.md, context/*.md, context/readiness/*.md, GLOSSARY.md, docs/adr/, docs/*.md, standards/*.md, .claude/skills/orchestrator/*.md. Follow DOC-2 in standards/documentation.md: a fact belongs in one file and every other file points at it, so also flag a commit that copies a rule into a second file. Never fill in context/readiness/approval_status.md. If no document needs a change, answer ok. Otherwise answer not ok and list each document with the reason, ids and paths only, never a secret or personal data.
